summary.intent: Update the codebase map documents (primarily CONCERNS.md) to reflect work completed in phases 28-33, then clean up stale references and sensitive data from planning docs.
summary.outcome: CONCERNS.md and STRUCTURE.md were updated to reflect resolved concerns and structural changes from phases 28-33; stale references (legacy POC, docker host IP, phase-specific status labels) were cleaned from planning docs; changes were committed to a PR (FSM1/cipher-box#390).

repo: Phase 28 removed legacy POC directory (commit ee9bcd4e4) and replaced 127 console.* calls with structured logger at apps/web/src/lib/logger.ts

Phase 30 added Grafana Faro observability (apps/web/src/lib/faro.ts) and Prometheus metrics (apps/api/src/metrics/), but registerFaroTransport() is defined and never called — logger errors don't reach Faro
Phase 31 decomposed useSharedNavigation.ts (1199→378 lines) into 6 files and FileBrowser.tsx (964→362 lines)
Phase 32 resolved sync FilePointer blocking on macOS; Phase 33 completed the same fix for Windows (crates/fuse/src/platform/windows/read_ops.rs)
apps/web/src/lib/web3auth/hooks.ts retains 12 unguarded console.time/timeEnd calls not covered by Phase 28
FUSE production code has 19+ mutex lock().unwrap() sites that can cause cascading panics on poisoned mutex
IPNS unenrollment is fire-and-forget with no persistence across tab closure
192.168.133.114 (docker host IP) was present in 15 planning files across 30 occurrences — sanitized to <docker-host>

code.finding: Legacy POC concern was stale — POC directory was removed in Phase 28 (commit ee9bcd4e4)
Docker host IP reference was stale and unnecessary in env vars table
Status column in env vars table contained phase references and 'generated' labels that were unnecessary noise

workflow: When main has diverged, stash specific files, hard reset to origin/main, then restore the stash — avoids merge conflicts while preserving in-progress work
Re-run mapper agents after pulling in new phase work rather than manually editing, since agents do a more thorough audit
Codebase map docs should not contain internal IP addresses, phase references in status columns, or references to removed directories — these become stale quickly
The gsd-codebase-mapper agent reliably identifies both resolved concerns AND new concerns introduced by the work it's reviewing

friction: Initial commit diverged from origin/main because Phase 33 was merged mid-session, requiring a stash/reset/restore dance before re-running the concerns mapper
The concerns mapper ran twice due to the diverged branch issue — first pass was partially wasted work
Mapper agent produced CONCERNS.md with a stale legacy POC entry despite Phase 28 having removed it — required manual correction
STRUCTURE.md env vars table had phase-specific status labels that needed a separate cleanup pass after the mapper ran
open_items: registerFaroTransport() is defined but never called — logger.error/warn calls don't reach Faro (new concern in CONCERNS.md)
web3auth/hooks.ts has 12 console.time/timeEnd calls not covered by Phase 28 logging migration

IPNS unenrollment is fire-and-forget with no persistence across tab closure
folder.service.ts (1059 lines) and bin.service.ts (971 lines) are still large candidates for future decomposition
